name: A-Skip Drill
description: Running mechanics drill — knee-drive and triple-extension pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Skip forward, driving one knee to hip height, same-side arm driving back, opposite arm forward. Alternate. 20-30 m sets.

name: A-Skip Running Drill
description: Dynamic running mechanics drill — knee drive and foot strike.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, skip forward driving one knee up to hip height with dorsiflexed foot. Opposite arm swings forward. Strike down-and-back with the ball of the foot. Alternate legs in a rhythm.

name: Alpine Kick-Step Traverse Sim
description: Side-step with weight shift on steep ground — replicates alpine kick-step traverse on snow/ice.
instructions_excerpt: Find a 30-45 degree slope (or box at that angle). Take small kick-steps across the slope, engaging edge of foot. 10-15 steps per direction.

name: B-Skip Drill
description: A-skip with a paw-back — trains the active foot plant.
instructions_excerpt: Skip forward driving the knee up, then kick the foot out and pull it back to plant under the hip. Alternate. 20-30 m sets.

name: Barefoot Grass Strides
description: Short barefoot strides on grass — foot-intrinsic strength and form reset.
instructions_excerpt: On a flat grass field, do 4-6 barefoot strides of 50 m at easy pace. Focus on soft mid-foot landing.

name: Beach-Tennis Lateral Lunge Drill
description: Low lateral lunges + racquet swings — beach-tennis and paddle footwork.
instructions_excerpt: Step into a deep lateral lunge, swing racquet across. Reset, other side. 10 per side.

name: Capoeira Ginga Drill
description: The fundamental capoeira back-and-forth rocking step — foundation for every movement.
instructions_excerpt: Alternate stepping back with each leg, hands in guard moving opposite to the rear leg. Maintain a low, fluid rhythm for 2-3 min.

name: Casting Practice Drill (Fly Fishing)
description: Deliberate fly-casting drill in dryland with a rod or dowel — tempo and shoulder coordination.
instructions_excerpt: With a fly rod (no line) or dowel, perform 30-50 casts focusing on 10-2 o'clock stroke, stopping crisply. Alternate arms.

name: Clay-Pigeon Follow-Through Drill
description: Slow-motion horizontal tracking drill — trap/skeet/sporting-clays follow-through.
instructions_excerpt: Mount an unloaded shotgun (or dowel). Track a horizontal line across the wall smoothly, pulling the trigger-finger midway, follow-through to the far side. 5 per side.

name: Cyclocross Dismount-Remount Drill
description: Repeated cyclocross-style running dismount and remount on flat ground — specific to the CX course skill set.
instructions_excerpt: Ride slowly, unclip, swing leg over and land running, carry bike 10-15 m, remount on the fly. 6-10 reps.

name: Deep-Water Fall Entry Drill
description: Controlled entry from height into deep water — safe fall practice specific to deep-water soloing.
instructions_excerpt: From a pool edge or platform 3-5 m high, jump feet-first in a pencil (legs together, arms crossed over chest) into deep water. Exit, reset, repeat. 5-10 entries.

name: Disc-Golf Pivot-Throw Rotation
description: Standing pivot-throw rotation with a light band — replicates backhand disc throw.
instructions_excerpt: Band anchored at chest height. Stand side-on. Drive band across body in a smooth pivot, hip-first. 10-12 per side.

name: Dog-Pull Harness Walk (Bikejoring Prep)
description: Harness-assisted walk with a dog — gait and cue foundation for bikejoring and canicross.
instructions_excerpt: With the dog in a pulling harness, leash attached to a hip belt. Walk then jog while the dog pulls ahead. 10-20 min.

name: Dolphin Kick (Poolside / Dryland)
description: Dryland mimicry of the dolphin-kick pattern — hip mobility + core coordination.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench with legs extended off the end. Perform a controlled dolphin kick pattern from the hips. 30 seconds per set.

name: Double-Foot Stomp Reset
description: Fast double-foot stomp + combat reset — neural primer for fencing/TKD/BJJ start positions.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in stance. Stomp both feet hard in place, simultaneously reset hands to guard. 10 reps. Rest 30s. 3 rounds.

name: Fell-Running Technical Descent Run
description: Short fast downhill with technical footing — fell-running and mountain-run descent specific.
instructions_excerpt: On a rough trail or grass slope 5-15% down, run 100-200 m at confident fast-downhill pace. Walk back. 3-5 reps.

name: HEMA Grapple-Throw Entry
description: Step-and-grip entry drill — HEMA ringen and sword-grapple specific.
instructions_excerpt: From fighting stance, step with lead foot to partner/bag level, grip, rotate hips to throw entry. 6-8 per side.

name: HEMA Longsword Zornhau Drill
description: HEMA-style oblique cut (zornhau) — builds the core rotation and grip-transition for longsword arts.
instructions_excerpt: From vom Tag (shoulder-held) guard, deliver an oblique diagonal cut down-and-across. Chain 10-15 alternating sides. Focus on edge alignment.

name: Judo/BJJ Bridge-Hip-Escape Flow
description: Chained bridge + hip-escape drill — grappling ground-movement specific.
instructions_excerpt: Supine. Bridge (hips up), then shrimp to the side (hip escape). Alternate sides. 8-12 reps.

name: Karate Kata Flow Drill
description: Slow-tempo kata-like movement chain — blends mobility and kinetic-chain coordination.
instructions_excerpt: Chain 6-8 karate stances (zenkutsu, kokutsu, kiba-dachi) with transitions and blocks at slow tempo. 3-5 min continuous.

name: Kendo Men-Strike Footwork Drill
description: Suri-ashi slide-step with overhead shinai strike — kendo-specific.
instructions_excerpt: From shizen-tai, slide-step forward right foot, strike overhead with shinai, recover. 8-12 per side.

name: Olympic Snatch-Balance (Empty Bar)
description: Snatch-balance drill with empty bar — Olympic-weightlifting technique progression.
instructions_excerpt: Grip bar wide overhead behind neck. Press bar up as you drop into an overhead squat. Drive back to standing. 5-6 reps.

name: Paper-Cut Test Drill (Iaido Edge Alignment)
description: Slow-motion cutting drill against a suspended paper strip — edge-alignment skill.
instructions_excerpt: Hang a paper strip at shoulder height. With bokken or dowel, practice slow-motion cuts that clip the paper without tearing it. 10-15 cuts.

name: Polo Mallet Swing Rotation
description: Rotational swing with dowel simulating polo mallet — polo-specific shoulder and core rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Hold dowel one-handed at chest. Rotate into forehand swing, finish high. 10-12 per side.

name: Reverse-Launch Wing Handling Drill
description: Reverse-facing handling pattern simulating a kiting paraglide wing.
instructions_excerpt: Face backward holding risers (or two handles on a band anchored to a wall). Lean back, pull risers, turn, step forward, and sprint. 5-8 reps.

name: Roll & Break-Fall Drill
description: Controlled forward and backward rolls and break-falls — foundation for aikido, sambo, judo adjunct.
instructions_excerpt: From a crouch, perform a forward shoulder roll. Stand. Repeat. Add back break-falls and side rolls. 5-8 reps each direction.

name: Sambo Belt-Grip Takedown Entry
description: Repeated belt-grip entry step — sambo-specific takedown setup drill.
instructions_excerpt: Face partner or heavy bag. Step in with aggressive belt/hip grip, drop levels, drive forward 2-3 steps. Reset and repeat. 6-8 entries per side.

name: Sambo Takedown Rehearsal (Single-Leg)
description: Single-leg takedown rehearsal against a heavy bag — sambo and wrestling shot specificity.
instructions_excerpt: From a combat stance, shoot to a single-leg on a heavy bag: drop step, knee tap, lift. 8-10 shots per side. Slow, precise reps first.

name: Scrambling Down-Climb Drill
description: Slow, deliberate down-climbing on easy terrain — trains the reversed-movement brain needed for class 3-4 exits.
instructions_excerpt: On a V0/V1 problem or easy traverse, climb up, then slowly reverse each move exactly, facing into the rock. Maintain three points of contact.

name: Scrambling Three-Point Step-Down Drill
description: Slow, deliberate step-downs on rough terrain maintaining three points of contact — scrambling-specific skill.
instructions_excerpt: On a short rocky step 1-2 ft high, face in, place hands, step down one foot at a time keeping two hands + one foot contact. 10-15 reps.

name: Shotgun Mount Rotation Drill
description: Shoulder-mount with pivot — trap/skeet/sporting-clays swing motion.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a lightweight dowel (shotgun sim). Mount to shoulder while pivoting feet through the swing direction. 10-12 per side.

name: Shrimping / Hip Escape
description: BJJ fundamental movement — also a mobility staple for all grapplers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, feet flat. Elevate hips and shoot them back and to one side, shrimping the hip away from an imaginary opponent. Plant one foot, push with the shoulder/forearm, shift hips, and repeat down the mat.

name: Single-Leg Pedal Drill (Trainer)
description: Unilateral pedaling on trainer — trains pedal smoothness and deficit leg.
instructions_excerpt: On a trainer, unclip one foot. Pedal smoothly with the other leg for 30s. Switch. Focus on eliminating dead spots through the stroke.

name: Skate Edge Lateral Pushes
description: Dryland lateral push drill — skating-wheeled and roller-derby specific stride.
instructions_excerpt: In skate stance, push off one booty to slide laterally onto the other foot. Alternate. 30-60s sets. Work on full weight transfer.

name: Skimboard Slide-Land Step
description: Running approach and slide-step landing — skimboarding-specific.
instructions_excerpt: From a 3-5 step run-up, plant one foot and glide into a narrow-stance squat, mimicking dropping onto a skimboard. 8-10 per lead side.

name: Sprinting-Masters A-Skip
description: Low-intensity A-skip warm-up drill appropriate for masters sprinters — grooves the sprint pattern without max load.
instructions_excerpt: Skip for 20 m with aggressive knee drive (knee to 90), foot dorsiflexed, tall posture. Walk back. 4-6 reps.

name: Stair Walk-Down (Pole-Assisted)
description: Pole-assisted stair descent — low-demand technique drill for trekking-pole coordination.
instructions_excerpt: Use trekking poles or broomsticks. Walk down a flight of stairs using poles like on a downhill, planting pole before weight shifts. Slow and rhythmic.

name: Stance Transition Drill (Deep Stances)
description: Chain of traditional stances (horse, bow, cat, forward) with controlled transitions — core skill for kung-fu and karate.
instructions_excerpt: Move through a sequence: horse stance to bow stance to forward stance to cat stance, each held 3-5s. Travel 10 m per set.

name: Stillness + Aim Drill
description: Static aim-hold over a target — breath + postural control for archery and clay shooting.
instructions_excerpt: Hold the bow (or a shotgun) in full-aim position over a dry target. Hold for 10-15s without shake. 6-8 reps with rest.

name: Stroller / Dog-Line Running Drill
description: Run drill with a pulling leash — canicross gait coordination.
instructions_excerpt: Attach a dog in a pulling harness to a bungee leash on a running belt. Run 15-30 min maintaining coordinated pace and cues.

name: Swing Rock-Step Drill
description: Foundational swing-dance rock-step pattern — rhythmic footwork drill.
instructions_excerpt: Stand. Rock step back onto the right foot, shift weight back to left, tap-step tap-step in the rhythm of swing timing. 2-3 min continuous.

name: Topgolf Club-Speed Swing Drill
description: Light-club overspeed swing — pure rotational speed training for casual golfers and Topgolf.
instructions_excerpt: Use a 5-iron or lighter club. 10 swings per side at 90-95% effort, focused on smooth tempo. 2-3 sets.

name: Topgolf Swing Tempo Drill
description: Slow-motion swing-tempo drill — for topgolf/range practice players without breaking form.
instructions_excerpt: Take a normal golf stance. Perform slow-motion swings (3 sec backswing, 3 sec downswing). 10 slow swings, 5 normal. Repeat.

name: Walk-and-Aim Drill
description: Walk forward while maintaining steady aim — rifle/shotgun/bow simulation in motion.
instructions_excerpt: Walk slowly and steadily while holding an aim line on a far target. 15-30 m sets. Quiet footfalls, steady breath.
